messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Paging Sam Park (on-call) — prompt-router-new-endpoint canary (deploy-2026-03-15-13, v0.4.1) error rate at 18% over 5m, latency p95 spike, automatic canary gate FAILED. PagerDuty: PD-78910.
Sam Park: I'm on it, looking at canary cluster logs and router traces. pulling metrics now.
Sam Park: initial quick check: 503s with upstream error 'model-mismatch' from backend pool A, mostly for long prompts (>2048 tokens).
Maria Chen: I kicked off the canary this morning. Did we change prefix/KV caching in v0.4.1?
Zoe Li: Yes, v0.4.1 includes a small KV cache refactor that touches cache key hashing — might explain mismatches with cached KV entries on the new endpoint.
Sam Park: OK that matches. Impact seems limited to requests routed to new-endpoint. Traffic is 10% prod (canary). Some enterprise customers (alpha group) routed there — seeing 15-30% failure rate for those sessions.
Carla Ruiz: Customer support pinged, one customer reported session resets and partial outputs, flagged as SEV2 for now.
Sam Park: Recommend immediate kill-switch flip for feature flag router:new-endpoint to 0% and failover to stable router. Can someone approve?
Maria Chen: I approve. Maria Chen: I'm enabling the kill-switch now via feature toggle service.
Maria Chen: Command logged: ```bash
curl -X POST https://ff.redwood.internal/toggles/router:new-endpoint -d '{"enabled":false,"actor":"Maria Chen","reason":"canary 503 spike"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
Deploy Bot: Feature flag router:new-endpoint set to false by Maria Chen at 2026-03-15T13:45:10Z. Rollout reverted; traffic rebalanced to stable-router.
Sam Park: Seeing immediate drop in error rate on the canary group — errors down to ~1.8% within 90s. Latency recovering.
Nate O'Connor: Good catch. Do we want to also abort the rest of the rollout and create a rollback artifact?
Maria Chen: Yes, aborting rollout pipeline and marking deploy-2026-03-15-13 as failed. I've triggered a rollback tag and stopped further canaries.
Maria Chen: Pipeline command: ```text
ci:abort deploy-2026-03-15-13 && tag rollback/deploy-2026-03-15-13
```
Sam Park: Noted. I'll collect logs and sticky traces for the failed requests (request IDs saved). Will attach to the incident ticket.
Zoe Li: Root cause hypothesis: KV cache key hash changes cause cache misses leading to fallback logic that expects a different model signature — backend responds with model-mismatch leading to 503.
Carla Ruiz: Customer impact: three alpha customers had degraded sessions for ~6 minutes before the kill-switch. Support already sent template apology and mitigation steps.
Sam Park: Creating incident ticket in Jira: RED-INC-4123, severity S2. Summary + link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-INC-4123
Incident Bot: Incident created RED-INC-4123 by Sam Park. Initial severity S2.
Nate O'Connor: I'll take second-oncall monitoring and follow up on postmortem. Sam, can you handoff once you've collected artifacts?
Sam Park: Handing off to Nate O'Connor. TL;DR: canary v0.4.1 KV hash change -> upstream model mismatch -> increased 503s for long prompts on canary; kill-switch toggled (router:new-endpoint=false) at 13:45:10Z; rollback pipeline aborted. Artifacts saved in /incidents/RED-INC-4123/artifacts (logs, traces, toggle-audit).
Nate O'Connor: Got it. I'll run additional checks on the rollback and monitor SLOs for next 30m. I'll also escalate to Research/Infra to validate cache key behavior.
Maria Chen: Action items: (1) revert KV cache refactor branch, (2) add integration test for cache key stability, (3) add canary gating assertion for long-prompt handling.
Sam Park: Also recommending a transient mitigation: add a circuit-breaker on model-mismatch to return graceful fallback instead of 503. File a tech-debt ticket.
Carla Ruiz: Support note: send status update to affected customers with what we changed and ETA for root cause + fix.
Nate O'Connor: Updating the incident channel and tagging SRE and Research. I'll ping again at 13:55Z with metrics snapshot.
Zoe Li: Will start a small repro locally with v0.4.1 and prior version to get deterministic failing case.
Sam Park: Thanks all. Leaving channel for now, Nate will own monitoring. If anything new, mention @Nate O'Connor. :thumbsup: 
Nate O'Connor: Monitoring: p50/p95/p99 trending back to baseline; errors under 2% for the affected cohort. Keeping incident open for postmortem and follow-ups.
Incident Bot: Reminder: incident RED-INC-4123 severity S2 — please fill initial postmortem template within 48 hours.
Maria Chen: Adding a short postmortem owner: Maria Chen. Will draft and include code change revert.
Carla Ruiz: Support will send a customer follow up in 1 hour.
Nate O'Connor: Handoff complete at 13:55:50Z — closing active on-call thread, incident remains open for docs. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
